params.body:
"News" has been in the menu since the About dropdown went in, and on the Dutch and French site it led to the English overview with an English menu: news was the one part of the site that existed in English only. This makes the overview and the posts exist in all three languages.

## What changes for a visitor

- **`/nl/news` and `/fr/news`**: the overview in Dutch and French, with the menu, heading, date and links in that language.
- **`/nl/news/<slug>` and `/fr/news/<slug>`**: every post has an address in each language. The language switch on a post now stays on that post.
- **A post with a translation** shows it: title, summary, text, photo captions and alt texts, and the labels around it ("In dit verhaal", "Al het nieuws").
- **A post without one** shows its English text under the Dutch or French menu, with one line saying it exists in English only. Its canonical address is the English page, and the text is marked `lang="en"`.
- **Homepage**: the "Latest news" block is now on the Dutch and French homepages too.
- **CyberSec page**: the link to the story of the first event goes to the post in the page's language, and no longer says "(in English)".

## How

- **`src/lib/news.js`** (new): `loadPosts()` reads the posts once per build; `inLanguage(post, lang)` gives the post as it reads in one language and says whether that is a translation.
- **`NewsPost.astro`, `NewsIndex.astro`, `LatestNews.astro`** (new components): the post page, the overview and the homepage block, each used by three thin page files. The English pages render as before.
- **`src/lib/i18n.js`**: `/news` and `/news/<slug>` count as translated routes, so links, the language switch and `hreflang` follow.
- **`Layout.astro`**: optional `canonicalPath`, used by a post that shows English text under `/nl` or `/fr`.
- **`sanity/post.js`**: a post gets an optional `translations` field (`nl`, `fr`, each with title, excerpt and body) and `altNl` / `altFr` on gallery photos. The Studio's own copy of the schema needs the same fields before translations can be edited there; the site reads them either way.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 29 passed, with new tests for the language fallback and for the news routes. `npm run build` and `npm run check:built`: no contact number.
- Without a translation in Sanity (the state on main today): the Dutch and French post pages build, show the English text with the note, and point their canonical to the English page.
- With the Dutch and French versions of the first post, in a local preview: post, overview, homepage block and CyberSec link in en, nl and fr at 1440 wide, the post also at 390: right language, internal links stay in the language, seven headings in the "In this story" list, no horizontal scroll, no page errors.
params.title: News in Dutch and French: the overview and the posts
